name: 独立开发者(做了十多款赚钱产品)
description: 前两个月跟一位独立开发者聊天，他做了十多款赚钱的产品，也因此过上了比较自由的生活。策略: 不同的产品放不同赛道分散风险。具体产品未具名但可参考其模式。

name: HamsterBase (稍后读工具)

name: 文字数カウントメモ (字数统计笔记)

description: Profitable event SaaS with $25K revenue, $20K profit, 80% margins, 200K+ page views. Scalable subscription model with low overhead and global demand.

name: Chrome Extension Revenue (Benchmarks)
description: Chrome扩展平均年收入$862K。5000活跃用户+2%付费转化+$10/月订阅=$1K/月MRR。Grammarly, Honey, LastPass等是成功案例。独立开发者案例: 近1万订阅者, $130K/月(2019); Closet Tools: $42K/月。

name: Lotus (Open Source Pricing Engine)
description: Open source pricing & packaging infrastructure for SaaS. Enables usage-based pricing, custom subscriptions, and billing experiments. Monetized via open-core model. Also: Meteroid (similar, cloud-native pricing/billing).

name: Micro SaaS Benchmarks (BigIdeasDB)
description: 8,699 SaaS startups tracked, 3,787 reporting active revenue. Average $4,298 MRR, median $145 MRR, 6.1% above $10K MRR. Micro SaaS growing at ~30% annually, projected $59.6B by 2030.
